posts.text:
There are 2 troubling things people should understand about all the reporting of Army Secretary Driscoll going to Trump to complain about Hegseth before resigning.

1, that Trump did not know what Hegseth was doing is a myth. 
2, that Trump would want Hegseth to stop is a delusion.
posts.summary: Trump knowingly enabled Hegseth's problematic conduct; would not have stopped it
